title: Chapter 350 Ksitigarbha Pavilion
content:
Chapter 350 Ksitigarbha Pavilion

The scale of Yingying Town is very large, even comparable to that of Shanhai City.

Various buildings are arranged in an orderly manner.

Some are dozens of stories high.

The styles of buildings vary greatly.

The people on the street are of different shapes and colors.

Some of them are wearing armor and carrying weapons, while others are in dire straits, like beggars.

Especially those with broken hands and feet, they may not have the opportunity to realize their dream of becoming Shura warriors in this life.

He walked around the whole town.

Wang Shuo found the Colosseum, the Arena, the Ksitigarbha Pavilion, the Treasure Pavilion and other places.

According to the introduction of Song Bo and others and Wang Shuo's own understanding.

Yingying Town currently has several major forces, which control the Colosseum, the Treasure Pavilion and other industries.

At the beginning, these organizations were to serve the public, but after countless years of evolution, they gradually became organizations that exploited the generals and became the dominant forces in Yingying Town.

The overlords who control these industries often change their masters, which is very chaotic.

For newcomers, these organizations have little to do with them, after all, they are just passers-by.

But for those who cannot enter the second level, they may have to live here for the rest of their lives. These forces have become a mountain that oppresses them. They either endure silently or join them.

But there are two places where no force dares to intervene directly.

That is the Dizang Pavilion and the Arena.

This is the original building of the War General Tower. The rules are controlled by the War General Tower. Anyone who intervenes will be directly wiped out by the War General Tower.

Wang Shuo first came to the central square and checked the current rankings.

The first place is Zuo Da, a top-level general with 99 Shura Orders.

Second, Baichuan Zhonggu, a top-level general with 99 Shura Orders.

Third, Jiang Song.

The following are: Lin Zhu, Nuoen, Zhao Kai, Lyon...

Wang Shuo found that the top 20 are all top-level generals, and the top 5 are only one Shura Order short.

As for the latter, the difference is much greater.

Wang Shuo thought that it should not be difficult for them to obtain the Shura Order. Perhaps they chose to stay here for other reasons.

Then, Wang Shuo went directly to the Ksitigarbha Pavilion.

This place can be said to be the favorite place for the generals who came to Yingying Town.

Because there are all kinds of skills and martial arts here.

And it is free for everyone to practice.

It is considered a basic welfare in the War General Tower.

The Ksitigarbha Pavilion is in the center of the town.

It is a stone house more than ten meters high and covers hundreds of square meters. Compared with the houses built by others, it looks much more shabby.

For example, the Treasure Pavilion opposite has carved beams and painted buildings, pillars and green tiles, and is magnificent.

But the Ksitigarbha Pavilion has its own sense of simplicity. Because of its long history, it makes people full of awe!

The Ksitigarbha Pavilion is not open to the public at any time.

Each person can only enter once a month.

Seeing people constantly entering, Wang Shuo was still a little puzzled. Can such a small building accommodate so many people?

Wang Shuo also walked in.

At this time, Wang Shuo felt that there was a different world inside.

Although everyone entered from the same door, after entering, Wang Shuo found that he was the only one in the whole hall.

It turned out that everyone who entered here was in an independent space.

Wang Shuo had to marvel that this war general tower was indeed a grand work.

After sighing, Wang Shuo began to observe the surrounding environment.

The whole hall was in a stone room, and the stones on the surrounding walls were full of various classifications.

Swords, spears, swords, and halberds, everything!

At the same time, on another wall, there were various internal skills for cultivation.

The third wall was a variety of weapons, but these weapons could only be used for people to practice and could not be taken out.

The fourth wall was a light door, obviously, it was the door to go out.

Wang Shuo was very excited when he saw these.
